## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- claim-5 remains conjectural: claims 2–4 establish only the three low-degree blocks, not global spanning, torsion-freeness, or absence of higher-degree residual classes.
- “Unit-pivot elimination” must allow integral row combinations for its stated equivalence with the quotient decomposition; elimination using selected original Pieri rows would be stronger.
- Minimality remains conditional on proving claim-5 and generation of \(J_v\) by either family.
